ns2:course.label: Supervision of Learning Environments
ns2:course.description: Methods, theories, and research applying to the supervision and evaluation of classroom practices in learning-centered schools; includes analysis and application of research in effective teaching practices, formative assessment and summative evaluation, data collection techniques, and professional development. Same as EPOL 538. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as EPOL 538. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
